select count(1) as totalRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when type = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as seedRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when gender = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as maleRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when gender = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as femaleRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when type = '0' and gender = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as femaleSeedRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when type = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as commodityRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when type = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as replacementRabbits from rabbits r where r.house_id in and r.is_active = true
and exists ( select 1 from batch_rabbits br where br.batch_id = #{batchId} and br.rabbit_id = r.id and br.is_active = true )

select count(1) as totalLitters, coalesce(sum(total_kits), 0) as totalKits, coalesce(sum(live_kits), 0) as totalLiveKits, coalesce(sum(coalesce(weaned_count, 0)), 0) as totalWeaned, 0 as successBreedingCount, 0 as failedBreedingCount from litters where house_id in
and batch_id = #{batchId}

select coalesce(sum(l.current_nursing), 0) from litters l where l.house_id in and l.status = 'NURSING'
and l.batch_id = #{batchId}
